def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    leftover = bins[valid_mask] - item
    mod = leftover % item
    priorities[valid_mask] = -mod
    return priorities

    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[valid_mask] - item

algorithm: {The new algorithm assigns priority based on the inverse of the ratio between the item size and the remaining capacity, penalizing bins with very small remaining capacity more heavily, while also incorporating a logarithmic scaling to moderate extreme values for better numerical stability.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_capacity = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Avoid division by zero and apply logarithmic scaling for stability
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining_capacity == 0, 1e-10, remaining_capacity)
    log_ratio = np.log1p(item / safe_remaining)
    priorities[valid_mask] = -log_ratio
    return priorities
